title: The Imitator Game: Benchmarking Robot Imitative Ability Beyond Action Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.22301v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humans imitate at the level of intent: given a demonstration, we infer its goal and carry it out with whatever tools, objects, and layouts are at hand. Current robot policies instead learn observation-to-action mappings from visual inputs and language instructions, without explicitly inferring the demonstrated task. Learning from human video thus remains largely trajectory-level: models can replay motions in near-identical scenes, but still struggle to imitate what the demonstrator intends rather than merely what they do. We introduce The Imitator Game, a four-level benchmark (L0-L3) that progressively widens the gap between the human demonstration and the robot's own scene, isolating where trajectory replay ceases to suffice and task understanding becomes necessary. We pair it with IG-10K, the largest environment-aligned paired human-robot dataset to date and the only one instantiated across all four levels in both real and simulated

translated_title: 模仿者游戏：超越动作预测的机器人模仿能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 人类在意图层面进行模仿：面对示范，我们会推断其目标，并使用手头的工具、物体和布局来执行。当前的机器人策略则从视觉输入和语言指令中学习观察到动作的映射，而不明确推断被示范的任务。因此，从人类视频中学习在很大程度上仍停留在轨迹层面：模型能在近乎相同的场景中重放动作，但难以模仿示范者的意图，而不仅仅是其行为。我们引入了模仿者游戏，这是一个四级基准测试（L0-L3），逐步扩大人类示范与机器人自身场景之间的差距，以隔离轨迹重放不再足够、任务理解变得必要的情况。我们将其与IG-10K配对，这是迄今为止最大的环境对齐的配对人类-机器人数据集，也是唯一在现实和模拟环境中跨所有四个级别实例化的数据集。
tldr: 本文提出“模仿者游戏”四级基准测试和IG-10K数据集，旨在评估和推动机器人从轨迹级模仿向意图级理解的关键转变。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Imitator Game, a four-level benchmark with the IG-10K dataset, to evaluate and advance robots from trajectory-level imitation to intent-level understanding.
